text:
Kaito Brennan is the designer of the Ninefold Stadium roof, the Ninefold Stadium Development Authority confirmed after unveiling the design on 14 March 2019.

The roof spans 212 meters and cost 87 million credits to build. Brennan served as lead designer on the project, according to the Authority.

The details appear in the Ninefold Stadium Structural Design Dossier (Revision C), which was formally ratified at the Authority's public board session.

Marisol Achterberg, Chair of the Ninefold Stadium Development Authority, confirmed Brennan's role at the announcement.

"Kaito Brennan is our lead roof designer, and this dossier records the design as it was approved," Achterberg said.

The unveiling took place at the stadium's official design announcement, where the roof design was presented publicly for the first time. The ratified dossier now serves as the Authority's formal structural record for the roof.
